s0101.literal: Prince Checheetu was enfeoffed Prince of Ningyuan.
s0101.idiomatic: Prince Checheetu was enfeoffed Prince of Ningyuan.

s0102.literal: An edict was reissued directing that powerful families in the capital bear corvée equally with the people.
s0102.idiomatic: An edict was reissued directing that powerful families in the capital bear corvée equally with the people.

s0103.literal: The relay households of Nayahu and Hundu'er suffered famine; they were relieved.
s0103.idiomatic: The relay households of Nayahu and Hundu'er suffered famine; they were relieved.

s0104.literal: On wuwu day the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to; accession was announced.
s0104.idiomatic: On wuwu day the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to; accession was announced.

s0105.literal: On jiwei day cave barbarians of Shaoqing Route became bandits; the Sichuan branch secretariat was ordered to capture them.
s0105.idiomatic: On jiwei day cave barbarians of Shaoqing Route became bandits; the Sichuan branch secretariat was ordered to capture them.

s0106.literal: Sacrifice was made to the Dunjia god at Xiangshan.
s0106.idiomatic: Sacrifice was made to the Dunjia god at Xiangshan.

s0107.literal: Grand councillors Wang Yi and others were ordered to investigate and account for shortfalls in grain and silks at the capital's granaries and storehouses, and strictly enforce the Karakorum wine prohibition.
s0107.idiomatic: Grand councillors Wang Yi and others were ordered to investigate and account for shortfalls in grain and silks at the capital's granaries and storehouses, and strictly enforce the Karakorum wine prohibition.

s0108.literal: On gengshen day officials who had overstepped their ranks were demoted; all were to hold the offices they had received.
s0108.idiomatic: On gengshen day officials who had overstepped their ranks were demoted; all were to hold the offices they had received.

s0109.literal: Baizhu, commissioner of the Grand Ceremonies Bureau, was made central secretariat grand councillor;
s0109.idiomatic: Baizhu, commissioner of the Grand Ceremonies Bureau, was made central secretariat grand councillor;

s0110.literal: the Western monk Yabbadari was made Yuan Yongyan Extended Teaching Tripitaka Dharma Master and granted a gold seal.
s0110.idiomatic: the Western monk Yabbadari was made Yuan Yongyan Extended Teaching Tripitaka Dharma Master and granted a gold seal.

s0111.literal: On renxu day the moon transgressed Fang.
s0111.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon transgressed Fang.

s0112.literal: Because of the accession, the palace guard troops were rewarded.
s0112.idiomatic: Because of the accession, the palace guard troops were rewarded.

s0113.literal: Thirty thousand horses were registered; they were granted to Mongol refugees and sent back to their departments.
s0113.idiomatic: 30,000 horses were registered; they were granted to Mongol refugees and sent back to their departments.

s0114.literal: Summer cloth was granted to Mongol households of Tong and Gu prefectures.
s0114.idiomatic: Summer cloth was granted to Mongol households of Tong and Gu prefectures.

s0115.literal: Tiemudie'er requested to participate in deciding government affairs; all ministers were forbidden from overstepping their ranks to memorialize on their own — this was approved.
s0115.idiomatic: Tiemudie'er requested to participate in deciding government affairs; all ministers were forbidden from overstepping their ranks to memorialize on their own — this was approved.

s0116.literal: On yichou day Renzong's mourning reached the end of wailing; Buddhist rites were performed for seven days.
s0116.idiomatic: On yichou day Renzong's mourning reached the end of wailing; Buddhist rites were performed for 7 days.

s0117.literal: On wuchen day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
s0117.idiomatic: On wuchen day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.

s0118.literal: Sea transport arrived at Zhigu; one thousand troops were mobilized for garrison defense.
s0118.idiomatic: Sea transport arrived at Zhigu; 1,000 troops were mobilized for garrison defense.

s0119.literal: Wang Xu was enfeoffed Duke of Jilin Commandery.
s0119.idiomatic: Wang Xu was enfeoffed Duke of Jilin Commandery.

s0120.literal: Enshrining Renzong alongside was deliberated; yin-yang taboos constrained the matter — a colored hall was temporarily erected southeast of the Great Chamber to receive the spirit tablet.
s0120.idiomatic: Enshrining Renzong alongside was deliberated; yin-yang taboos constrained the matter — a colored hall was temporarily erected southeast of the Great Chamber to receive the spirit tablet.

s0121.literal: On jisi day Mongol troops of Hejian, Zhending, Jinan, and other places suffered famine; they were relieved.
s0121.idiomatic: On jisi day Mongol troops of Hejian, Zhending, Jinan, and other places suffered famine; they were relieved.

s0122.literal: The maritime trade bureau was abolished; merchants were forbidden from off-season voyages.
s0122.idiomatic: The maritime trade bureau was abolished; merchants were forbidden from off-season voyages.

s0123.literal: Hui Muslims scattered in commanderies and counties were levied — each household two taels of package silver per year.
s0123.idiomatic: Hui Muslims scattered in commanderies and counties were levied — each household 2 taels of package silver per year.

s0124.literal: Land tax of the Liang-Huai, Jing-Hu, and Jiangnan east-west circuits was increased — two sheng added per dou.
s0124.idiomatic: Land tax of the Liang-Huai, Jing-Hu, and Jiangnan east-west circuits was increased — 2 sheng added per dou.

s0125.literal: Refugees of Dadu, Jingzhou, and other places were relieved; grain and horses were granted, and they were sent back to the northern frontier.
s0125.idiomatic: Refugees of Dadu, Jingzhou, and other places were relieved; grain and horses were granted, and they were sent back to the northern frontier.

s0126.literal: On wuyin day Mongol and Han relay posts were restored to the Communications Court.
s0126.idiomatic: On wuyin day Mongol and Han relay posts were restored to the Communications Court.

s0127.literal: Someone presented a seven-treasure belt; through a close attendant it was presented to the Emperor, who said: "Since We ascended the throne, We have not heard you recommend the worthy, yet you present belts for others — this is using profit to tempt Us; return it.
s0127.idiomatic: Someone presented a seven-treasure belt; through a close attendant it was presented to the Emperor, who said, "Since We ascended the throne, We have not heard you recommend the worthy, yet you present belts for others — this is using profit to tempt Us; return it.

s0128.literal: " That month, Left Guard garrison fields suffered drought and locusts; Left Wing garrison fields had insects eating wheat seedlings; Bozhou suffered flooding.
s0128.idiomatic: " That month, Left Guard garrison fields suffered drought and locusts; Left Wing garrison fields had insects eating wheat seedlings; Bozhou suffered flooding.

s0129.literal: Fifth month, on jimao day monks were forbidden from using relay posts; seals previously granted were still collected.
s0129.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jimao day monks were forbidden from using relay posts; seals previously granted were still collected.

s0130.literal: On gengchen day Shangdu resident commissioner He Boiyan was executed in the market for receiving an edict in informal dress; his household was registered.
s0130.idiomatic: On gengchen day Shangdu resident commissioner He Boiyan was executed in the market for receiving an edict in informal dress; his household was registered.

s0131.literal: On xinsi day prolonged rain at Runing Prefecture damaged wheat and millet; five thousand shi of grain were issued for relief sale.
s0131.idiomatic: On xinsi day prolonged rain at Runing Prefecture damaged wheat and millet; 5,000 shi of grain were issued for relief sale.

s0132.literal: On dinghai day the Pukou wanhu office of Yuanling County was abolished.
s0132.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Pukou wanhu office of Yuanling County was abolished.

s0133.literal: On jichou day central secretariat ministers requested forbidding unauthorized memorials for appointments; the Emperor said: "Yet I fear I may forget, or someone may seize an opportunity to memorialize and indiscriminately bestow titles — you must report again.
s0133.idiomatic: On jichou day central secretariat ministers requested forbidding unauthorized memorials for appointments; the Emperor said, "Yet I fear I may forget, or someone may seize an opportunity to memorialize and indiscriminately bestow titles — you must report again.

s0134.literal: " Garrison farms at Cheng Hai and Wutiao River were re-established.
s0134.idiomatic: " Garrison farms at Cheng Hai and Wutiao River were re-established.

s0135.literal: Monks were ordered to pray for rain.
s0135.idiomatic: Monks were ordered to pray for rain.

s0136.literal: Yunnei, Feng, and Sheng commanderies and counties of Datong suffered famine; thirteen thousand shi of grain were issued on loan.
s0136.idiomatic: Yunnei, Feng, and Sheng commanderies and counties of Datong suffered famine; 13,000 shi of grain were issued on loan.

s0137.literal: Left chancellor Asan was dismissed and made Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor; Baizhu was made central secretariat left chancellor; Nalihu and Tash Haiya were both made central secretariat grand councillors; Jirharang was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0137.idiomatic: Left chancellor Asan was dismissed and made Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor; Baizhu was made central secretariat left chancellor; Nalihu and Tash Haiya were both made central secretariat grand councillors; Jirharang was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0138.literal: On gengyin day the moon transgressed Heart.
s0138.idiomatic: On gengyin day the moon transgressed Heart.

s0139.literal: On xinmao day associate administrator Qincha was dismissed and made Academician of Scholarly Worthies.
s0139.idiomatic: On xinmao day associate administrator Qincha was dismissed and made Academician of Scholarly Worthies.

s0140.literal: The gate guards and winter-stationed guards of the Upper Capital were relieved.
s0140.idiomatic: The gate guards and winter-stationed guards of the Upper Capital were relieved.

s0141.literal: Envoys were dispatched to monopolize foreign goods of Guangdong; the Shaanxi wine prohibition was relaxed.
s0141.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to monopolize foreign goods of Guangdong; the Shaanxi wine prohibition was relaxed.

s0142.literal: On renchen day Yan Hai of Karakorum buried more than three thousand corpses of the starved; his gate was commended.
s0142.idiomatic: On renchen day Yan Hai of Karakorum buried more than 3,000 corpses of the starved; his gate was commended.

s0143.literal: On guisi day the moon transgressed Heavenly Dog.
s0143.idiomatic: On guisi day the moon transgressed Heavenly Dog.

s0144.literal: On jiawu day troops and commoners of Shenyang suffered famine; twelve thousand five hundred strings of notes were granted for relief.
s0144.idiomatic: On jiawu day troops and commoners of Shenyang suffered famine; 12,500 strings of notes were granted for relief.

s0145.literal: On yiwei day the posthumous title of the late emperor was requested at the southern suburb.
s0145.idiomatic: On yiwei day the posthumous title of the late emperor was requested at the southern suburb.

s0146.literal: On bingchen day Venus transgressed Net.
s0146.idiomatic: On bingchen day Venus transgressed Net.

s0147.literal: Imperial kin and powerful families were forbidden from evading corvée and committing crimes.
s0147.idiomatic: Imperial kin and powerful families were forbidden from evading corvée and committing crimes.

s0148.literal: On wuxu day someone reported that Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor Asan, central secretariat grand councillor Heilü, censor-in-chief Tetuha, and Palace Domestic Service commissioner Shiliemen and others, together with the late Yaosumou's wife Yilieshiba, plotted to depose and install; Baizhu requested to investigate the case; the Emperor said: "If they invoke the Grand Empress Dowager as pretext, what then?
s0148.idiomatic: On wuxu day someone reported that Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor Asan, central secretariat grand councillor Heilü, censor-in-chief Tetuha, and Palace Domestic Service commissioner Shiliemen and others, together with the late Yaosumou's wife Yilieshiba, plotted to depose and install; Baizhu requested to investigate the case; the Emperor said, "If they invoke the Grand Empress Dowager as pretext, what then?

s0149.literal: " An order commanded all be executed; their households were registered.
s0149.idiomatic: " An order commanded all be executed; their households were registered.

s0150.literal: Duke Wang Shixian of Longxi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Longyou.
s0150.idiomatic: Duke Wang Shixian of Longxi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Longyou.

s0151.literal: On xinchou day privy council administrator Temür Tuo was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0151.idiomatic: On xinchou day privy council administrator Temür Tuo was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0152.literal: On renyin day surveillance censors requested abolishing excessive titles for monks, Daoists, artisans, and actors, and the expenses of building temples and keeping beasts.
s0152.idiomatic: On renyin day surveillance censors requested abolishing excessive titles for monks, Daoists, artisans, and actors, and the expenses of building temples and keeping beasts.

s0153.literal: On jiachen day an edict to the realm proclaimed the execution of Asan, Heilü, He Boiyan, and others.
s0153.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict to the realm proclaimed the execution of Asan, Heilü, He Boiyan, and others.

s0154.literal: An edict directed all offices to be diligent in government affairs daily; the negligent were to be punished.
s0154.idiomatic: An edict directed all offices to be diligent in government affairs daily; the negligent were to be punished.

s0155.literal: On bingwu day censor Liu Heng requested establishing charity granaries and stripping monks and Daoists of official rank.
s0155.idiomatic: On bingwu day censor Liu Heng requested establishing charity granaries and stripping monks and Daoists of official rank.

s0156.literal: An edict commanded the capture of Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Mailu, son of Yilieshiba; his household was still registered.
s0156.idiomatic: An edict commanded the capture of Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Mailu, son of Yilieshiba; his household was still registered.

s0157.literal: On dingwei day Wang Chan was enfeoffed Prince of Yunnan and dispatched to guard that territory.
s0157.idiomatic: On dingwei day Wang Chan was enfeoffed Prince of Yunnan and dispatched to guard that territory.

s0158.literal: Poyang County of Raozhou presented auspicious grain — one stalk with six ears.
s0158.idiomatic: Poyang County of Raozhou presented auspicious grain — one stalk with 6 ears.

s0159.literal: The property, fields, and dwellings of He Boiyan, Shiliemen, and Asan were granted to Tiemudie'er and others.
s0159.idiomatic: The property, fields, and dwellings of He Boiyan, Shiliemen, and Asan were granted to Tiemudie'er and others.

s0160.literal: Sixth month, on jiyou day Palace Domestic Service commissioner Miximi was exiled to Diamond Mountain.
s0160.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jiyou day Palace Domestic Service commissioner Miximi was exiled to Diamond Mountain.

s0161.literal: Because of Tetuha's and Shiliemen's past conduct, livestock and property seized from others were returned to their owners.
s0161.idiomatic: Because of Tetuha's and Shiliemen's past conduct, livestock and property seized from others were returned to their owners.

s0162.literal: On jiayin day former crown prince household intendant Chuangwu'er was executed.
s0162.idiomatic: On jiayin day former crown prince household intendant Chuangwu'er was executed.

s0163.literal: An epidemic struck the capital; Buddhist rites were performed at Wanshou Mountain.
s0163.idiomatic: An epidemic struck the capital; Buddhist rites were performed at Wanshou Mountain.

s0164.literal: On yimao day Prince Chang Axi's department suffered famine; ten million strings of notes were granted for relief.
s0164.idiomatic: On yimao day Prince Chang Axi's department suffered famine; 10 million strings of notes were granted for relief.

s0165.literal: Merit in suppressing Asan and others was rewarded; Baizhu and those below him were granted gold, silver, and notes in varying amounts.
s0165.idiomatic: Merit in suppressing Asan and others was rewarded; Baizhu and those below him were granted gold, silver, and notes in varying amounts.

s0166.literal: On bingchen day Henan branch secretariat grand councillor Yesun Temür was summoned to the capital; the Guangping Prince seal of Tetuha was collected.
s0166.idiomatic: On bingchen day Henan branch secretariat grand councillor Yesun Temür was summoned to the capital; the Guangping Prince seal of Tetuha was collected.

s0167.literal: On dingsi day Jiangxi branch secretariat left chancellor Tuotuo was made censor-in-chief; Director of the Imperial Clan Zhaluhuochi Temür Buqa was made privy council administrator.
s0167.idiomatic: On dingsi day Jiangxi branch secretariat left chancellor Tuotuo was made censor-in-chief; director of the Imperial Clan Zhaluhuochi Temür Buqa was made privy council administrator.

s0168.literal: On wuwu day the Palace Domestic Service was abolished.
s0168.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Palace Domestic Service was abolished.

s0169.literal: The Guangdong pearl-collection office was abolished; regular officials were placed in charge of the matter.
s0169.idiomatic: The Guangdong pearl-collection office was abolished; regular officials were placed in charge of the matter.

s0170.literal: Privy council administrator Tash Temür was enfeoffed Duke of Ji State.
s0170.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Tash Temür was enfeoffed Duke of Ji State.

s0171.literal: On jiwei day it was fixed that on the frontier, those guilty of stealing and breeding livestock were to be assigned corvée to the various departments; if they did not reform, punishment was to follow interior law.
s0171.idiomatic: On jiwei day it was fixed that on the frontier, those guilty of stealing and breeding livestock were to be assigned corvée to the various departments; if they did not reform, punishment was to follow interior law.

s0172.literal: On gengshen day the moon transgressed Dipper.
s0172.idiomatic: On gengshen day the moon transgressed Dipper.

s0173.literal: One hundred twenty wrestlers were granted one thousand strings of notes each.
s0173.idiomatic: 120 wrestlers were granted 1,000 strings of notes each.

s0174.literal: On xinyou day an edict exempted monks from miscellaneous corvée.
s0174.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict exempted monks from miscellaneous corvée.

s0175.literal: On renxu day an edict directed that envoys arriving at the capital — for major affairs five days, for minor affairs three days — then be dismissed.
s0175.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict directed that envoys arriving at the capital — for major affairs 5 days, for minor affairs 3 days — then be dismissed.

s0176.literal: That night the lunar eclipse reached totality.
s0176.idiomatic: That night the lunar eclipse reached totality.

s0177.literal: On guihai day the moon transgressed Wall Formation.
s0177.idiomatic: On guihai day the moon transgressed Wall Formation.

s0178.literal: On yichou day famine-stricken people of the northern frontier were relieved — those with wives and children one thousand five hundred strings of notes, the solitary seven hundred fifty strings.
s0178.idiomatic: On yichou day famine-stricken people of the northern frontier were relieved — those with wives and children 1,500 strings of notes, the solitary 750 strings.

s0179.literal: A new tent hall of the Great Ancestor was built.
s0179.idiomatic: A new tent hall of the Great Ancestor was built.

s0180.literal: Dao Luogemu of the western barbarians surrendered.
s0180.idiomatic: Dao Luogemu of the western barbarians surrendered.

s0181.literal: On dingmao day Venus transgressed Well.
s0181.idiomatic: On dingmao day Venus transgressed Well.

s0182.literal: Prince Amulitai was granted banquet robes and a pearl cap.
s0182.idiomatic: Prince Amulitai was granted banquet robes and a pearl cap.

s0183.literal: On wuchen day the relay households of Leijia were granted fifteen thousand strings of notes.
s0183.idiomatic: On wuchen day the relay households of Leijia were granted 15,000 strings of notes.

s0184.literal: On xinwei day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.
s0184.idiomatic: On xinwei day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

s0185.literal: On jiaxu day ten northern frontier princes including Bo Yaotai were each granted twenty-five thousand strings of notes.
s0185.idiomatic: On jiaxu day 10 northern frontier princes including Bo Yaotai were each granted 25,000 strings of notes.

s0186.literal: Border people were granted three months' relief grain.
s0186.idiomatic: Border people were granted 3 months' relief grain.

s0187.literal: Kipchak Buddhist rites at Ningxia were repaired; two million one hundred twenty thousand strings of notes were granted.
s0187.idiomatic: Kipchak Buddhist rites at Ningxia were repaired; 2,120,000 strings of notes were granted.

s0188.literal: On dingchou day the Red City Zhongdu Guard was changed to the Loyal Support Guard Personal Army Commanderate, subordinate to the Privy Council.
s0188.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Red City Zhongdu Guard was changed to the Loyal Support Guard Personal Army Commanderate, subordinate to the Privy Council.

s0189.literal: The Zhangqing Office, Yanfu Office, Herds Directorate, Palace Standards Office, and Liaoyang wanhu office were abolished; the Empress Insignia Office was restored as the Repair Treasures Bureau, the Good Governance Office as the Chief Resident Commissionerate, and the Inner Steward Office, Yanqing Office, and Selection Inspectorate were restored to primary third grade.
s0189.idiomatic: The Zhangqing Office, Yanfu Office, Herds Directorate, Palace Standards Office, and Liaoyang wanhu office were abolished; the Empress Insignia Office was restored as the Repair Treasures Bureau, the Good Governance Office as the Chief Resident Commissionerate, and the Inner Steward Office, Yanqing Office, and Selection Inspectorate were restored to primary third grade.

s0190.literal: Yidu suffered locusts; Jingmen Prefecture drought; Dizhou, Gaoyou, and Jiangling flooding.
s0190.idiomatic: Yidu suffered locusts; Jingmen Prefecture drought; Dizhou, Gaoyou, and Jiangling flooding.

s0191.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuyin day Prince Quru Buqa was granted fifteen thousand strings of notes.
s0191.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on wuyin day Prince Quru Buqa was granted 15,000 strings of notes.

s0192.literal: Zhang Liusun, patriarch of the Mysterious Teaching, was ordered to perform ritual observances at Chongzhen Palace.
s0192.idiomatic: Zhang Liusun, patriarch of the Mysterious Teaching, was ordered to perform ritual observances at Chongzhen Palace.

s0193.literal: On renwu day a garrison farm at Puding Route was established; two thousand garrison soldiers from Wusa and Wumeng were divided and sent there.
s0193.idiomatic: On renwu day a garrison farm at Puding Route was established; 2,000 garrison soldiers from Wusa and Wumeng were divided and sent there.

s0194.literal: Karakorum grain was transported to the Zhakun granary to supply frontier troops; thirty thousand horses and forty thousand sheep were purchased for impoverished frontier soldiers.
s0194.idiomatic: Karakorum grain was transported to the Zhakun granary to supply frontier troops; 30,000 horses and 40,000 sheep were purchased for impoverished frontier soldiers.

s0195.literal: On guiwei day horses were registered in Datong, Xinghe, and Jining routes to be distributed to the guards.
s0195.idiomatic: On guiwei day horses were registered in Datong, Xinghe, and Jining routes to be distributed to the guards.

s0196.literal: On jiashen day, because the imperial carriage was about to visit the north, the left and right wing armies were mobilized to dig wells on the northern frontier.
s0196.idiomatic: On jiashen day, because the imperial carriage was about to visit the north, the left and right wing armies were mobilized to dig wells on the northern frontier.

s0197.literal: Privy council administrator Mailu and Hadan were both made Liaoyang branch secretariat grand councillors.
s0197.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Mailu and Hadan were both made Liaoyang branch secretariat grand councillors.

s0198.literal: On bingxu day Prince Mainu and others were granted two hundred fifty thousand strings of notes.
s0198.idiomatic: On bingxu day Prince Mainu and others were granted 250,000 strings of notes.

s0199.literal: On dinghai day the moon transgressed Dipper.
s0199.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon transgressed Dipper.

s0200.literal: Fire struck the department of Princes Gaozhu and others; three months' relief grain and fifteen thousand strings of notes were granted.
s0200.idiomatic: Fire struck the department of Princes Gaozhu and others; 3 months' relief grain and 15,000 strings of notes were granted.
